Headline: Your team adopted AI. Your infrastructure didn't. Founder, TransformBy10X. 20 years running agency operations on Madison Avenue.
About:
I spent twenty years running agency operations on Madison Avenue: briefs, feedback, approvals, delivery, and every handoff in between. Context always mattered, but work moved at human speed, so people could carry it.

AI changed the speed. Drafts went from three to thirty. Versions went from a week apart to an afternoon apart. The handoffs didn't change, so the context started dropping in the gap.

That's the problem I work on now. Your team adopted AI. Your infrastructure didn't. AI makes more work possible than traditional BizOps can carry.

At TransformBy10X I build the structure that carries it: the folders, the decision record, the rule for how a change travels, and the files every person and every AI reads first.

PROOF shows where your work stalls in 15 answers, at no charge: transformby10x.ai/proof
BACK builds the structure from those answers.

I also write Prompting Circumstance, real exchanges with AI with the typos left in, at erikhbush.com.

Infrastructure before intelligence.
